method.expert_chain: Count routed_expert q4_gate_up* operations; independently require equal q4_mm* and scatter_experts counts and no other routed_expert operations.
method.expert_only: Every operation in the command has stage routed_expert.
method.mixed: At least one routed expert chain and at least one other stage. All observed other stages in mixed commands are shared_expert.
method.decode_phase_assignment: Partition observed decode offsets using the two disjoint intervals implied by each sealed workload; verify all48layers and10expert chains per layer/offset.
method.histogram: Command counts, not token-row counts or GPU-time weights. Prefill/append expert chains can process multiple token rows.
method.durations: No duration sums, exclusive timing attribution, or speed projection.

sources.timing_kind: existing command groups; mixed stages are not isolated kernel costs
instrumented per-dispatch compute passes; submission boundaries preserved

limitations: Both source traces predate native packed-Q4 integration and use reference Q4 on build81e6f5ced54d2802716bd5dd211e47428da0d39d65d55b8fe7564ce94bd26b79. They do not describe candidate routing or prove the later slowdown mechanism.
commands.json uses existing command boundaries but enables CPU profiling; its101600operations cover16decode forwards per phase, not long-context qualification.
dispatch.json uses a separate compute pass per dispatch and changes scheduling. Its34.5%/38.7%decode overhead and52.4%/54.7%one-expert shares must not be pooled with commands.json.
Detailed expert read records are bounded to48passes and8192records per request phase; decode details cover onlyoffset72, while command operation coverage covers both windows.
The production group4setting is an upper bound. Read completions determine smaller emitted groups and shared-only work.
No inference of exclusive GPU costs, cache-hit rates across unrecorded tokens, full-request improvement, or causal responsibility follows from occupancy counts.

recommendation.next_condition: Resident-backed all-hit actual execute_experts coordinator replay, separately declared before running.
recommendation.rationale: Native fixed-group replay retains GPU gain; the older command trace shows one-expert groups dominate. First reproduce lease admission/ready scanning/event-loop/reap ownership through the actual coordinator, with maxgroup1 primary andmaxgroup4 diagnostic, before adding SSD or preceding resident computation.
controls: Same original Q4 records, saved inputs, exact output positions and arithmetic; reference versuspacked alternate withincondition.
Preload each required expert into a bounded actual ExpertCache before timing; assert everytimed acquisition ready_hit and zero new reads.
Use actualexecute_experts+encode_expert_rows(direct=false), ReadPool8 and existing2groupcap; retain12GiBbudget and admitted resident allocations.
Report coordinator_wait_ns separately from Metal cpu_gpu_wait_ns; the event-loop wait is not currently included in Metal GPU wait counters.
Preserve scatter01 no_clear_native_gain and all earlier request rejection statuses; no samplepooling or automaticpromotion.
recommendation.important_source_distinction: Metal::wait already uses CompletionEvents::wait/ticket and callbacks. The additional coordinator condition tests leases, polling, scheduling and dualreap ownership, not callbacks versus no callbacks.
recommendation.followup_if_survives: Next declare actual bounded read arrivals to actualexecute_experts, measuring emittedgroupoccupancy; add preceding shared/resident computation in a separate condition.
